notes.proposed: TFV-first sparse-state + differentiable continuous MPC. Direct hydraulic observations are the frozen sparse sensor layout plus actuator readbacks and causal rainfall; the 932-node state is reconstructed, not direct SWMM truth.
notes.no_control: No-supervisory-RTC: native [CONTROLS] disabled and no Python writes; the exact event forcing, DWF, initial conditions and passive/local device physics remain.
notes.internal_rtc: Strong native engineering comparator. The exact event forcing/DWF/initial conditions are paired with the frozen network [CONTROLS] payload at runtime. It may evaluate true SWMM rule variables on the native RULE_STEP and is therefore intentionally not an equal-information/equal-frequency comparator.
notes.auto_rbc: Strong causal local rule comparator. Actuator-adjacent current true SWMM node depths are normalized by INP design max depth; no forecast or event-specific outcome tuning. Its local-sensor information budget may exceed the Proposed sparse layout and must be disclosed.
notes.efd: Storage-aware Equal Filling Degree comparator using current true storage depths at controlled storages. No future information or event-specific outcome tuning. Its storage-sensor information budget is disclosed separately from Proposed.
notes.all_open: Diagnostic extreme: all eligible SWMM settings ramp toward 1.0 from the common Python first control decision under the frozen temporal-continuity envelope.
notes.all_closed: Diagnostic extreme: all eligible SWMM settings ramp toward 0.0 from the common Python first control decision under the frozen temporal-continuity envelope.

excluded_formal_strategies.hold: Debug-only because a frozen first-decision readback can collapse toward No-control.
